An API versioning design standard that only applies if the change involves APIs. It is a design judgment that no kind can check.
A rule that resource endpoints use plural nouns. It only applies to API work and is a semantic code property that no kind can check.
A limit on URL nesting depth. It only applies to API work and no deterministic kind covers it.
Rate-limit response headers. It only applies to API work and is a semantic code property that no kind can check.
Reversible migrations. It only applies if the change adds migrations, which cannot be expressed as an observable predicate, and no kind can check it.
Model/table naming conventions. It only applies to database model work and is a semantic code property that no kind can check.
Timestamps on tables. It only applies to database schema work and no kind can check it.
